text_block_list.text:
Returning to the front of the station, I 
ran into Cesario and the others holding 
shopping bags.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? It's so unfair you three are 
going out together! I wanna hang out too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Oh no, it wasn't for fun. I just 
finished running an errand for the dorm 
mother.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go hang out now! You come too, 
Trainer! Pretty please? Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say no, you won't listen, will 
you? Good grief, I guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Let's drop off our bags first, and 
then go hang out together properly!

She's been working hard at her training 
lately. ...In that case, let's make today 
all about doing whatever she wants.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Time for the third song! I'm not letting 
go of this mic yet~♡”

Clapping along to the music, I watch over 
her, thinking she's really going all out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngaah~! I sang my heart out ♡ My throat's 
bone dry...

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me. I have brought your carrot 
juice.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ? Who could this belong to?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I wanna drink that! I just finished 
mine off a second ago.
choice_data_list: It's yours, Pandora. I ordered it earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, for real? That's a lifesaver~♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Trainer's read was spot-on! You're 
amazing, Pandora-san!

text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, maybe so~♡

text_block_list.text:

baby pink would've been better after all~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey~ Bring over that first one we 
looked at~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've been holding onto that this whole 
time? ...You're pretty used to this, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're very good at providing 
support. I'm learning a lot ♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you are the trainer of the genius 
Pandora-chan, after all! This much is only 
natural~♡"

text_block_list.name: Family Restaurant Waiter
text_block_list.text: ...Will that be all for your order?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Trainer, did you order anything 
for yourself?
choice_data_list:
Ah, no. But I think it'll probably be 
fine.
No, but I think it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ that was delicious♡ I want some 
parfait too, so I'll give the rest to 
y-o-u♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
P-Pandora's Trainer is really amazing... 
They see right through everything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, stop it, you're making me blush~♡♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where is Pandora-san's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Said she's gonna go check if I left 
anything behind~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Pandora-san's Trainer is truly so 
thoughtful and attentive.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah? You're my Trainer, so isn't this 
pretty much normal?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Normal", huh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I am, I totally am♡ Suuuuper doing it♡ 
...Right, Trainer?

Sorry to keep you waiting... wait, what

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? Just sayin' "thanks for everything~ 
mwah♡"♡♡

text_block_list.text:
So, where to next~? Pick somewhere nice 
for us♡

text_block_list.text:
All right! Next, I'll take a photo with

text_block_list.text:
